A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study. Their full text, equations, figures, tables and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching relocated material.

before.justification: v1 reports original model-training experiments on CLEVR-style data, including generalization accuracies and representation analyses in Sections 4–8 and appendix Tables 1–7.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments, numerical results and representation analyses, including the appendix tables.

M1.justification: The multimodal Transformer, masked-token prediction and diversity, burstiness and hue-intervention procedures remain the same. The new hyperparameter section documents the existing method without establishing a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same CLEVR-style scenes, four object attributes and held-out shape–color combinations. No dataset, domain, task or distinct evaluation scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The same eight-color baseline and controlled data-distribution and model-capacity variants participate in the comparisons. The added literature citations do not introduce evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Splits, sample counts, perturbation grids and evaluation procedures are retained. New appendix hyperparameters are disclosures, not revisions to stated settings. Figure 10's correction from cosine distance to cosine similarity agrees with the cosine-of-angle metric already specified in v1 Section 8.2.

E4.justification: The sample-efficiency, capacity, controlled-NMI, disentanglement and parallelism analyses already appear in v1 and remain in v3. The appendix correlation analysis is also retained without additional tests.

E5.justification: Both versions report three training seeds with means and standard errors, and p-scores calculated from 3,500 pairs over five runs. Pearson correlations and their p-value reporting in appendix Table 1 are unchanged.

E6.justification: The plotted results and numerical entries in appendix Tables 1–7 are unchanged. Both report shape OOD accuracy of 0.6% with eight colors and 90.0% with 216 colors, and an overall p-score–performance correlation of 0.73.

T1.justification: The task formalization, distributional-property definitions and mathematical descriptions of NMI, disentanglement and p-score are retained. Neither version adds formal theorems or proofs; the corrected Figure 10 terminology leaves its formula unchanged.

C1.justification: The introduction recasts the listed NMI contribution: v3 acknowledges the NMI–generalization association as established and instead emphasizes diversity's effect at matched NMI. This elevates an existing finding rather than adding evidence; the central three-property efficacy claims remain.

C2.justification: Section 8.1 changes from describing disentanglement as desirable for systematic generalization to presenting its role as unsettled, with contrary findings. The conclusion correspondingly replaces increased disentanglement with increased diversity in its explanation of the gains.

D1.justification: New appendix Section 11 supplies essential missing settings: 16×16 patches, masking probability 0.15, four Transformer layers and four heads, Adam with learning rate 0.0001, batch size 256 and 1,000 epochs. The abstract also adds a code-access link, substantially expanding reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 9 adds a dedicated discussion connecting the parallelism mechanism to the linear representation hypothesis, feature directions and feature contamination. Section 8.1 additionally incorporates contrary disentanglement research. Together these substantially expand and qualify the mechanism's positioning relative to prior work.

P1.justification: v3 edits explanatory paragraphs and captions, standardizes SG/ID/OOD terminology, revises the contribution list and adds acknowledgements and a hyperparameter section. The main section sequence and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: The same eleven figures and seven tables remain, with revised placement, a compact author block and appendix reflow. Captions clarify Figure 7's eight- versus 216-color panels and correct Figure 10's metric terminology; Figure 11 gains more explicit panel labels.

improvement.justification: v3 improves reproducibility through the newly documented training recipe and code-access link. Its treatment of disentanglement is more qualified, and the added literature better contextualizes parallelism. These provide a clear but limited overall improvement to the existing study, whose experimental scope and reported evidence remain unchanged.
